servers.name: personal
servers.guidance: Indexed mail and Drive first. Use search (detail=concise|full), calendar_query, calendar_change, commitments, memory_search, memory_write, read_url. Sync/outbox/auth are not agent tools. Prefer Evidence [E#] from the lead system prompt before filesystem when the user names attachments, people, or threads.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.guidance: Local disk only—not Gmail/Drive ingested mail. Use search (personal pack) first for mail/Drive. Default search is MINDOS_HOME (project), not whole ~. For personal files: mindos_fs_list("~") then glob/grep with root=~/Downloads|Desktop|Documents; deep=True only if they want a wide scan. Configure agents.filesystem.search_paths for your usual folders. Destructive: preview then confirmed=True.

servers.name: convert
servers.guidance: Local conversion; source unchanged. mindos_fs_locate or mindos_convert_file (paths from user words). Batch: mindos_convert_batch previews then confirmed=True.

servers.name: fetch
servers.guidance: Backend for read_url (PDF/HTML pagination). Do not call fetch_* directly for user summarize requests—use read_url instead. search_web only for open-web queries without a URL.
